Definition: from G1909 and G1487; thereupon, i.e. since (of time or cause):--because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing that, since, when.
BiblicalUsage: Epei is a hinge word — since, because, seeing that, for then. Paul leans on it when he reasons: since God is judge, since grace is grace, since Christ has appeared once to put away sin. It is the word that carries an argument from what is true to what must follow.
TheologicalSignificance: The gospel is not a feeling but a case that holds together, and this little word carries the argument from what is true to what must follow. I believe Paul's reasoning is worth imitating: start from what God has done, and reason forward from there.
